text.p: Tropical cyclone 08B, with 85 mph winds, is still off the coast of Andhra Pradesh India..about 50 miles east-northeast of Nellore. It is moving towards the northwest at 5 mph. It is still a significant risk to shipping but it is also spreading rain into the coast. Rain will become heavy as the cyclone makes landfall in 6 hours. Flooding is likely and mudslides possible after the system moves inland. Strong winds and a storm surge will impact the coastal areas, especially north of where it makes landfall. The system should rapidly weaken as it continues inland later on Thursday.

Tropical Cyclone 08S is a moderate risk to shipping in the southwest India Ocean as top winds are now 80 mph. It should slowly strengthen to about 90 mph during the next 24-48 hours. It will mostly affect shipping during this time but it could threaten Mauritius, Reunion or eastern Madagascar in about 48-72 hours.
THERE ARE NO FURTHER EMERGENCY STATEMENTS AT THIS TIME
